This PR changes the source used by `highlightPreview` before resampling. - [patrick-hudson/put.gd-desktop#1369](https://github.com/patrick-hudson/put.gd-desktop/pull/1369): Adds pixelated blur previews. This PR changes the source used by `blurPreview` and adds shared sanitized source rendering. - [patrick-hudson/put.gd-desktop#1370](https://github.com/patrick-hudson/put.gd-desktop/pull/1370): Documents pixelation’s redaction-aware rendering and export order. This PR changes redaction sanitization in canvas and preview rendering.
Merge Risk: Minimal · up to 1194b

The change sanitizes redacted pixels before preview scaling. No concrete merge-blocking risk was identified. Per the PR description, the GUI regression tests cover redaction edges across zoom, effects, crop, and view changes.
Security architecture risk: Low · up to 1194b

The change strengthens protection against covered image content influencing displayed redaction edges. No introduced or worsened security issue was established. Remaining uncertainty concerns rendering behavior across supported platforms and allocation-failure conditions, rather than expanded access or privileges. **Retained concerns** No architecture-level concerns identified.
Security review details

**Security Blast Radius** - _inferred_ — The assessed confidentiality exposure is covered image content influencing an open document’s displayed canvas or effect previews. The compared entrypoint changes add local rendering capabilities, not a demonstrated new remote, cross-tenant or privileged access path. **Trust Boundaries and Controls** - _observed_ — The display control separates confidential base pixels from visible redaction-edge output by replacing covered samples in edge patches before filtering. The initial draw is not itself fully sanitized; protection depends on completing the mask and edge-replacement stages. Export separately overwrites covered pixels before applying effects. **Resilience and Maintainability Implications** - _inferred_ — Empty-input returns precede painter mutation, and normal rendering balances save and restore operations without changing document state. These properties limit persistent control drift between paints. Allocation-failure behavior and all supported rendering backends remain unverified; source inspection alone does not establish universal fail-closed behavior.
